name: Fujiwara no Kanesuke
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 27); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 933.

poems.title: Oh! rippling River Izumi
poems.author: Fujiwara no Kanesuke
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 27
poems.text:
Oh! rippling River Izumi,
That flows through Mika plain,
Why should the maid I saw but now
And soon shall see again
Torment my love-sick brain?

poems.title: 27. みかの原 わきて流るる 泉川 (Mika no hara wakite nagaruru Izumi-gawa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Kanesuke
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
みかの原 わきて流るる 泉川
いつみきとてか 戀しかるらむ
